deterministicContract.rationale: The current evidence includes a hash-addressed source AAC stream and six contiguous listening excerpts covering 0-85.009819 seconds, and the independent evaluator accepts the audio carrier and KU-24 finding as substantively evidenced. However, the canonical validator detects non-speech audio only through a canonical non-speech modality token. CAR-AUDIO-NONSPEECH uses modalityKeys [audio-stream, bounded-listening, music-or-sfx], so deterministic validation returns non_speech_audio:not_explicitly_inspected. It also requires every system_inference unit to contain explicit reasoning; KU-24 has evidence but no reasoning field, so internal_unsupported_inference fails. These machine-contract failures are conjunctive and cannot be offset by count gates.
